The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
Pattern.compile("([^/@]*)(/([^/@]*))?@([^/@]*)");
realm = match.group(4);
```
Reason:
The regex pattern used for parsing Kerberos principal names did not correctly capture the realm component, as it was defined to match only up to the fourth group. This led to the realm being incorrectly assigned, causing potential misinterpretation of the principal names during SPNEGO authentication.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
Pattern.compile("([^/@]+)(/([^/@]+))?(@([^/@]+))?");
realm = match.group(5);
```
Reason:
The updated regex pattern correctly captures the realm component by ensuring that it is matched as the fifth group. This change allows for proper extraction of the realm from the Kerberos principal name, thus preventing authentication failures due to incorrect mappings.
